items.text: Erring on the side of negative here. In concept, very promising. A real-time with pause spacer sim, where you can strip/salvage/scavenge ships in order to make a living in a post-apocalyptic (at least for Earth) world? Sounds great! It just isn't actually very smooth or fun to play at the moment, lacks a lot of UI/administrative features, and lacks tutorials/explanations/wiki-information that you need to get by without trial and error.
items.text_zh: 在这里倾向于负面评价。从概念上讲，非常有前途。一个实时暂停的太空模拟游戏，你可以在一个后末日（至少对地球而言）的世界中拆解/打捞/拾荒飞船以谋生？听起来很棒！只是目前玩起来实际上并不十分流畅或有趣，缺少很多UI/管理功能，并且缺少教程/说明/wiki信息，你需要这些才能避免反复试错。

observations.evidence: lacks a lot of UI/administrative features

items.text: Great game and dev is very involved in the community. Only con I have at the moment is lack of save/load menu. There is a way around this which is in the comments but menu may or may not be added to game in future  so will possibly be a permadeath game.
items.text_zh: 很棒的游戏，开发者非常积极参与社区。目前我唯一的缺点是缺少保存/读取菜单。有一个变通方法在评论里，但菜单未来可能会也可能不会加入游戏，所以这可能会是一款永久死亡游戏。
